node.title: Cyclic-fiber agreement descends to an interleaved quotient list
node.statement: If M|gcd(n,k), exact K_M-invariant agreement supports of size A for RS[F,H,k] inject into the common-support M-interleaved list of RS[F,H^M,k/M] at agreement A/M. Hence the general projection-collision theorem bounds the periodic class by floor(L(|F|-1)/(|F|-L)), and by the ordinary quotient-row list size L whenever L^2<|F|. If M is the intrinsic stabilizer size, the descended support is aperiodic; exact_support_interleaving_projection bounds this class in terms of the ordinary aperiodic quotient-row list without losing the support property.
